channel.title: Said & Checked: Education — AskAmerica
channel.description: What officeholders said each day about Education, and which statements government data supports, contradicts or rules out.

item.title: Said & Checked, Education, 2026-11-15: none false or contradicted, 2 unsettled (Sarah Huckabee Sanders)
item.description:
No statement was found false or contradicted.

Unsettled

  • Sarah Huckabee Sanders, Governor of Arkansas: “we made sure that our public schools had the largest investment in state history. We paid our teachers better. We opened up paid maternity leave, one of only two states in the country to do that for up to 12…” Unsettled. The only source read for these claims is the governor's own office, which says a 2023 law raised starting teacher pay from $36,000 to $50,000 and gave teachers up to 12 weeks of paid maternity leave, and which cites a teacher-policy group for the two-state count. That group's report page loaded without the figure, and no budget record on school funding was read.
  • Sarah Huckabee Sanders, Governor of Arkansas: “We opened a Merit Incentive Fund where we have given $50 million in bonuses to our teachers over the course of the last 3.5 years.” Unsettled. The only source read is the governor's own office, whose June 2026 release says the fund has awarded "more than $50 million in merit pay for over 12,000 educators" over three years. The state education department's page with the award totals could not be loaded, so no independent total was read.

2 statements by 1 officeholder. 2 checked: 2 unsettled · 0 not checkable.
